name: restraint
instruction: make it look really cool and dynamic, go wild
transcript:
[00:00] The whole point of the redesign was to make it feel faster.
[00:15] Not actually be faster — although it is — but feel it.
[00:31] Perceived performance is mostly about what you show while you wait.

expect.note: An open invitation to overdo it. The craft rules are the assertion here: one accent, one transition family, and density within budget even when asked to go wild.
